verdict.rationale: Temporal workflows are written as ordinary code: an independent evaluator describes "long-running business logic as ordinary code (Workflows)", Activities are "a normal function or method", and there is a TypeScript SDK walkthrough. Automatic checkpointing is documented through resume-exactly-where-left-off execution and replay that does not repeat completed Activities. A user notes the trade-off is that workflow code must be fully deterministic. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement contrasting code-first authoring with YAML or a DSL, a documented list of supported language SDKs beyond scattered mentions, and first-party docs on the determinism constraints of workflow code.
